llm_fields.description: The scheme provides training in artistic and technical skills to entrepreneurs from religious minority communities and offers a loan of ₹50,000 at 4% interest to be repaid in 36 installments, with a possible subsidy component.
llm_fields.eligibility: Applicants must be aged 18 to 55, be permanent residents of the state, belong to a state religious minority community, have a family income not exceeding ₹3.50 lakh per annum, not have availed benefits under any other KMDCL scheme (excluding the Arivu Scheme) in the last 5 years, have no family member employed in government PSUs, and must not be a loan defaulter in KMDC.
